posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Can I just say how I appreciate that Paul has embraced the "making things up" mantle with flying colors? The bit where he was asked about the various Sentinels corporations was great.

Also WalkingTarget grabbed some piccies of Christopher's canes to add to his summary notes: https://imgur.com/a/qGBGGlN

(The context is that earlier that day in the Letters Page chat Christopher was making a joking old man rant about kids these days, someone joke asked if he needed a stick to wave at those kids, I said my old woman self is envious because I bet that Christopher actually has a fancy cane to shake and he confirmed he did and he'd show them if I asked. Which of course I did because heck yes I want to see fancy canes.)
